verdict.rationale: The only on-topic evidence is the vendor's llms.txt describing Elastic as 'an open source search, analytics, and AI platform.' This is a single thin first-party claim: it names no license, links no source repository, and does not say whether the Observability solution itself is covered. 'Open by design' (elastic-docs-24) refers to OTel and Prometheus openness, not source licensing, so it earns no credit. Missing for 10: the specific open license, a link to a public source repository, confirmation that the Observability components are included, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license
